# Josie Pye

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c23 P18](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0018), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c25 P46](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0046), [v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034)</sub>

## Appearance

Josie Pye is described as a fat girl with sharp facial expressions and a habit of smiling maliciously. She wears flounces on all her dresses to stay stylish and attends gatherings pompadoured and frilled.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c31 P8](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0008), [v2 c14 P35](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0035)_

## Personality

Josie is defiant, malicious, and possesses a notoriously sharp tongue. She takes pleasure in making uncharitable speeches and humiliating others, though she is easily driven by competitive envy. She lacks imagination and tact, frequently asking blunt or intrusive questions. Despite her unpleasant demeanour, she exhibits natural confidence and agility when challenged.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c26 P2](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0002), [v1 c26 P6](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0006), [v1 c30 P31](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0031), [v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c37 P32](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0032)_

## Goals

- Attend college for education's sake without needing to earn a living  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c35 P14](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0014)</sub>

## History

At school in Avonlea, Josie Pye frequently caused friction among her classmates. She once peeped at her book during a spelling lesson and sneered at Anne Shirley during various punishments. During a gathering, after showing off her skill walking a board fence, she dared Anne to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's roof, which resulted in Anne falling and breaking her ankle. During preparations for a school concert, Josie became sulky when she was not cast as the fairy queen in a dialogue. She later joined the Queen's Academy preparation class, where she openly boasted that she only sought higher education for its own sake rather than to earn a living. She successfully passed the Entrance examinations, scraping through with three marks to spare. While studying at Queen's Academy in Kingsport, she gained a reputation as the sharpest-tongued young lady in attendance. Following graduation from Queen's, she chose to return for another year of study rather than teach, and her home hosted a farewell party hosted by the Avonlea Victoria Improvement Society.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), [v1 c23 P18](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0018), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034), [v3 c2 P1](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0001)_

## Background by volume

- Belongs to the prominent Pye family of Avonlea, whose members are notorious for being disagreeable and running things  <sub>[v2 c9 P17](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0017), [v1 c37 P33](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0033)</sub>
- Her family's cousin is Aunt Atossa  <sub>[v3 c11 P41](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0041)</sub>
